rationale: The price has bounced off the $21.00 support level and is showing a series of higher lows on the 1-minute candles, indicating a loss of immediate downward momentum. With the price trading back toward the 9-EMA and failing to break the support level decisively, the original thesis of an imminent breakdown is currently invalidated. Closing the position now preserves capital and avoids the risk of a further mean reversion toward the VWAP.
